name: Duplex apartment
description: Two mirror-image dwellings over two storeys, each with its own stair and front door.
credit: Duplex Apartment, Common Building Information Model Files, National Institute of Building Sciences (NIBS) buildingSMART alliance and U.S. Army ERDC, 2011.
licence: Publisher states no licence; shown with credit.

name: Vienna apartment building (TU Wien)
description: A real building in Vienna on seven levels, modelled to test escape-route checks: 111 rooms, 81 doors (32 flagged as fire exits), four stairs and two ramps.
credit: Fischer, S., Schranz, C., Urban, H., Pfeiffer, D., Flamm, L. (2024). Real-World Test Model for Escape Route Analysis in IFC format (2.0.0). TU Wien. CC BY 4.0; unchanged.

name: buildingSMART sample scene
description: buildingSMART's small IFC4 sample building: three slabs, four walls, two spaces.
credit: "ifc silly sample scene", buildingSMART International, Sample-Test-Files (PCERT sample scene).
licence: No licence file in the repository; shown with credit.

name: Office, two storeys
description: Two storeys, a corridor with ten rooms per floor, a stair and an exit at each end.
credit: Generated for Topologic Studio by tools/make_example_ifcs.py.

name: Courtyard ring
description: A corridor round a closed core with one exit: every start has two ways out. Rotated 30 degrees.
credit: Generated for Topologic Studio by tools/make_example_ifcs.py.

name: Office building (NIBS)
description: A two-storey office with 99 rooms: open offices, conference rooms, server, telecom, electrical and UPS rooms. Try sprinklers, extinguishers and the performance check.
credit: Office Building, Common Building Information Model Files, National Institute of Building Sciences (NIBS) buildingSMART alliance and U.S. Army ERDC, 2011 (NBU_OfficeBuilding_Arch).
licence: Publisher states no licence (the DURAARK repository at TIB, which holds the same file, lists CC0); shown with credit, removed on request.

name: Medical clinic (NIBS)
description: A two-storey medical and dental clinic with 269 spaces: waiting areas, exam and dental rooms, communication and electrical rooms, a computer room and plant. Its graph is large (about 34,000 nodes) and takes a few seconds to build.
credit: BSI (2020) "Medical-Dental Test Files," buildingSMART International (Community Sample Test Files), from the NIBS Common BIM Files Clinic (2011).

name: Institute building (KIT)
description: KIT's office test building on five levels, from the basement to the attic: 82 spaces, 77 doors and four stairs. Its graph has about 12,500 nodes.
credit: AC20-Institute-Var-2 ("Phantasy Office Building", ArchiCAD 20, IFC4), KIT IFC Examples, Institute for Automation and Applied Informatics (IAI), Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT), 2017.
licence: Published by KIT for unrestricted use; credited as the publisher asks. Unchanged from ifcwiki.org.

name: Smiley West terraced houses (KIT)
description: A terrace of houses from KIT's Smiley West project, from cellar to roof: 140 spaces, 170 doors (30 of them to the outside) and 30 stairs. Many short ways out, house by house. Its graph has about 12,500 nodes.
credit: AC-20-Smiley-West-10-Bldg (ArchiCAD 20, IFC4), KIT IFC Examples, Institute for Automation and Applied Informatics (IAI), Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT), 2017.
licence: Published by KIT for unrestricted use; credited as the publisher asks. Unchanged from ifcwiki.org.
